message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  While exact figures vary by source, the generally accepted estimates are:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑Belgian, Prussian)** | ~23 000 |
| **French** | ~25 000 |
| **Total** | ~48 000 |

These numbers include killed, wounded, and missing soldiers.  Some historians quote slightly higher or lower figures, but the consensus places total casualties in the range of 45 000–50 000.
